title: THE VALUE OF GEN-AI CONVERSATIONS: A BOTTOM-UP FRAMEWORK FOR AI VALUE ALIGNMENT
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It performs a qualitative analysis of conversational logs to identify value misalignments in a career-counselling context. Religion/faith is not a measured variable.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its analysis focuses on general ethical value alignment in a career-counselling conversational agent.
